originalMain.operation: append scoped require of own main addon; preserve original bytes

originalPreload.operation: append bundled IIFE containing electron-only narrow IPC; sandbox preload must not require a custom module

localSenderGate: registered imPlus webContents ID, senderFrame===mainFrame, exact approved file URL, original source hashes and navigation generation
remoteView: Electron 27 BrowserView inside original BrowserWindow, constrained to reserved addon strip; no companion BrowserWindow
remoteSenderGate: dedicated remote webContents ID, senderFrame===mainFrame, HTTPS https://csagent.tsim.tech/desktop-host, navigation/auth generations
runtimePreloadGate: contextIsolation must be confirmed at runtime before exposing the addon bridge; if unavailable stay HTML-only
requires: fresh installed version/hash after current updater settles
